==Description==
'''Living Statue''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 9 of the premium [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] track. It was made by c4rpye. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to interact with it.

Upon use, it will perform a stance then petrifies the player into stone.

It had a cost of {{GumDrops|180}} or {{Robux|32}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|815}} or {{Robux|335}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|41}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{Robux|425}}.
